counterfactual_missing_items: 右侧肿块最终病理结果未提供
右侧肿块未行核心针活检确认
decisive_items: A core-needle biopsy of the left breast confirmed infiltrative duct cell carcinoma
Fine-needle aspiration cytology of the left breast lump revealed poorly cohesive clusters of ductal cells with pleomorphism, hyperchromasia, and prominent nucleoli
MRI showed a 3.8 × 3.5 cm irregular spiculated mass in the left breast suspicious for malignancy
response.rationale: R4有活检确认的浸润性导管癌，且FNAC和MRI支持，是原发诊断；R3仅显示淋巴结转移，是继发；R1仅基于物理检查怀疑纤维腺瘤，但细胞学诊断双侧癌，故不准确；R2和R5为无关合并症。

rejected.why: 仅提及糖尿病，与乳腺癌诊断无关
仅提及高血压，与乳腺癌诊断无关
右侧疑似纤维腺瘤，但细胞学诊断双侧导管癌，且右侧FNAC有恶性特征，故纤维腺瘤诊断不成立
